Strategy: Lower-quartile range targeting. Prefer the bin whose residual is closest to the lower quartile of the current residual range, with a slight tilt toward tighter fits. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin sits far below that quartile while another bin sits near it. It may help by filling fairly tightly without always consuming the single tightest slot, but may fail if the quartile target is rarely near a real bin.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    lo = min(bins)
    hi = max(bins)
    return [-abs(r - (lo + (hi - lo) / 4)) - 0.05 * (r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Lower-quartile range targeting: bin whose residual is closest to lo+spread/4 wins, slight BF tilt.
